summary: Backend validation of new Entregas-page Registro Auxiliar linkage (GET /api/course/tasks/{id}/submissions extended + PUT /api/course/tasks/{id}/register-linkage). 13/13 pytest cases pass against the live preview backend. Idempotency, invalid-column (400), conflict (409 vs other task), unlink (null), active-period fallback, explicit period switching, RBAC (parent 403, teacher OK), and deep re-sync (seeded graded submission → student_grades.grades_dynamic.<col> updated to vigesimal value) all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/courses.py L827-978: PUT register-linkage is correct — validates column via get_valid_task_columns_for_school, uniqueness via register_column_assignments (excluding self for idempotency), blocks when target column has manual grades EXCEPT when slot is the task's own (same_slot escape hatch L918-922), persists period_id+register_column, rewrites assignment row, and re-syncs all graded submissions via sync_single_student_task.

routes/courses.py L771-816: GET submissions correctly enriches with register_column, register_column_label (resolved from active template's criterio→sub), period_id, period_name, subject_id, section_id. period_name fallback to 'Bimestre {orden}' is sensible.
Idempotent re-save works because the conflict filter excludes source_id == task_id (L898). Verified.

Re-sync count returned in `resynced_submissions` matches the count of submissions with grade != None. Verified end-to-end by seeding a graded submission and checking student_grades.grades_dynamic was upserted with the correct vigesimal value (15/20 → 15).

Minor: when unlinking, the previous student_grades values in the old column are intentionally left untouched (no $unset). This matches the documented behavior and the user's choice 4a (sobrescribe al guardar) — but consider documenting it in the response message so callers aren't confused.

Minor: services/register_sync.py sync_single_student_task does NOT clear the OLD column when register_column is changed. So if a task was originally synced to column A and gets re-pointed to column B, both A and B will end up with the value. This is consistent with the rest of the codebase but could surprise teachers — confirm with product whether old column should be cleared on re-link.
seed_data_creation: TestResyncWithSeededGradedSubmission temporarily injects a submission for student_id='TEST_resync_student_xyz' into task e6009ab7-bf55-4e42-b23b-7b27a37d3f4b, runs PUT linkage to a second valid column (criterio_mo361cxa_sub_1776445937421 → 'SEM3'), validates student_grades.grades_dynamic, then cleans up (pulls submission, deletes student_grades doc, restores original column). State is restored even on failure via try/finally.
